visual_description: The image is a portrait of actress Taraji P. Henson, shown from the chest up against a dark gradient background. She has voluminous curly black hair, wears subtle makeup with defined eyebrows and pink lips, and is dressed in a black one-shoulder top. Text overlays include “MENTAL HEALTH” in the upper left corner, her name “Taraji P. Henson” in large white serif font across her torso, and the subtitle “Starting the conversation to improve mental health” below it. A small vertical credit on the right edge reads “IMAGE COURTESY OF ERIKA BRACEY,” which is ignored per instructions. The layout centers her face and uses typography to frame the subject around the theme of mental health advocacy.
